tha-ap417:1.1: Nāgapallavaka.] Nagare Bandhumatiyā rājuyyāne vasām' ahaṃ / mama assamasāmantā nisīdi lokanāyako. // //
tha-ap417:2.1: Nāgapallavam ādāya Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ / pasannacitto sumano sugatam abhivādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap417:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ pallavam apūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap417:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Nāgapallavako thero i. g. a-ti.
